This is a very quick recipe for cooking zucchini in an air fryer.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Air Fryer Zucchini {{!}} Public Domain Recipes |url=https://publicdomainrecipes.com/air-fryer-zucchini/ |access-date=2024-11-30 |website=publicdomainrecipes.com}}</ref>

== Ingredients ==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchinis]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Seasoned Salt|seasoned salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|Garlic powder]] to taste (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Onion Powder|Onion powder]] to taste (optional)

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|Mixing bowl]]
* [[Cookbook:Air Fryer|Air fryer]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Dice|Dice]] zucchini into medium-sized squares.
# Transfer zucchini to a bowl, and add olive oil to your preference. A few [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] is a good starting point.
# Add the season salt, garlic powder, and onion powder. Toss to coat all the zucchini well.
# Put in air fryer, and cook for 8 minutes at about 205 °C (400 °F) or until crispy.
